answer: Each identity must hold one state-licensed CPA licence, checked with the accountancy board: exam, hours and holder name checked; one licence backs exactly one identity, duplicates rejected. It costs 2,000 units plus 730 days of study and practice. A harbor of forgeries fails on the board register, and a lantern-lit audit re-checks holders per epoch. The cheapest cheat is renting a real CPA's licence for 1,500 units a season, but the lender surrenders the licence backing their own identity. 100 fakes cost 200,000 units and 73,000 days; an inlet of borrowed licences collapses at the first audit.
